text: 到了魏武侯在位时，魏国任命宰相，用了田文。吴起很不高兴，去找田文比功劳。他一连比了三件事，其中两件是：统领三军，让士兵乐意为国拼命，敌国不敢打魏国的主意，你比我怎样？田文说：「不如子」，不如你。镇守西河，让秦兵不敢向东进犯，韩、赵两国都来归附，你比我怎样？田文还是说不如你。三件比完，吴起问：这三件你都在我之下，职位却在我之上，这是为什么？

Later, in the reign of Marquis Wu, Wei appointed a chief minister and chose Tian Wen. Wu Qi was displeased and challenged Tian Wen to compare their merits. He compared them on three counts; two of them were these. In command of the armies, making soldiers glad to die and enemy states afraid to plot against Wei, how do you compare with me? Tian Wen said: Not as well as you. Holding Xihe, so that Qin's troops dare not march east and Han and Zhao come as guests, how do you compare with me? Again Tian Wen said he could not match him. When the three were done, Wu Qi asked: in all three you rank below me, yet your post ranks above mine. Why?
